title: gcd times lcm recovers the product
statement: For all natural numbers a and b, gcd(a, b) * lcm(a, b) = a * b.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.gcd_mul_lcm : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.mul (AxNat.gcd x0 x1) (AxNat.lcm x0 x1)) (AxNat.mul x0 x1)))
